crossRefs.note: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice. Arise, flee to Laban, my brother, in Haran.
Isaac called Jacob, blessed him, and commanded him, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.
You shall answer and say before Yahweh your God, “My father was a Syrian ready to perish. He went down into Egypt, and…
He said to him, “What is your name?” He said, “Jacob”.
He said, “Your name will no longer be called Jacob, but Israel; for you have fought with God and with men, and have…
Jacob loved Rachel. He said, “I will serve you seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.”
These twenty years I have been in your house. I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six years for…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Paddan
people.line: The homeland of the patriarchs in Mesopotamia

translations.web: Jacob fled into the country of Aram, and Israel served to get a wife, and for a wife he tended flocks and herds.
translations.bsb: Jacob fled to the land of Aram and Israel worked for a wife— for a wife he tended sheep.
translations.kjv: And Jacob fled into the country of Syria, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept
translations.asv: And Jacob fled into the field of Aram, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept sheep.
